2: using CUDA, Printf
3: """Five in-process synchronized host-clock trials, JIT warmed before trial 1.
4: The same timed launch loop and reset/output boundaries apply to all models.
5: Full-array CPU checks are outside timing; raw outputs enable dual comparisons.
6: """
7: function run_trials!(launch!, reset!, readback, expected, repeats; atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
8:     repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
9:     reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()
10:     allok = true
11:     for trial in 1:5
12:         reset!(); CUDA.synchronize()
13:         start = time_ns()
14:         for _ in 1:repeats
15:             launch!()
16:         end
17:         CUDA.synchronize()
18:         secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
19:         got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
20:         length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
21:         maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
22:         for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
23:             a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
24:             b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
25:             ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
26:             maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
27:         end
28:         allok &= ok
29:         name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
30:         path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
31:         write(path,got)
32:         dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")
33:         @printf("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":%d,\"time_seconds\":%.12g,\"correct\":%s,\"checked_values\":%d,\"max_abs_error\":%.12g,\"max_rel_error\":%.12g,\"timing_region\":\"kernel_launch_loop_per_internal_repeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":%d,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"%s\",\"dtype\":\"%s\",\"count\":%d,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}\n",trial,secs,ok ? "true" : "false",length(got),maxabs,maxrel,repeats,path,dtype,length(got))
34:     end
35:     allok || error("CPU numerical verification failed")
36:     println("PASS")
37: end
38: end

50:     local_i = threadIdx().x

52:     i = (blockIdx().x - Int32(1)) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x

9:     tid = Int32((blockIdx().x - 1)) * Int32(blockDim().x) + Int32(threadIdx().x)
10:     @inbounds if tid <= N && mask[tid] != Int8(0)
11:         mask[tid] = Int8(0)
12:         num_edges = node_ne[tid]
13:         starting = node_start[tid]  # 0-based
14:         i = starting
15:         stop = starting + num_edges
16:         while i < stop
17:             id = edges[i + Int32(1)]  # 0-based id
18:             if visited[id + Int32(1)] == Int8(0)
19:                 cost[id + Int32(1)] = cost[tid] + Int32(1)
20:                 umask[id + Int32(1)] = Int8(1)
21:             end
22:             i += Int32(1)
23:         end
24:     end
25:     return
26: end

28: function bfs_update!(mask, umask, visited, over, N::Int32)
29:     tid = Int32((blockIdx().x - 1)) * Int32(blockDim().x) + Int32(threadIdx().x)
30:     @inbounds if tid <= N && umask[tid] != Int8(0)
31:         mask[tid] = Int8(1)
32:         visited[tid] = Int8(1)
33:         over[1] = Int8(1)
34:         umask[tid] = Int8(0)
35:     end
36:     return
37: end

39: function bfs_cpu!(N, node_start, node_ne, edges, mask, umask, visited, cost)
40:     while true
41:         stop = false
42:         for tid in 1:N
43:             if mask[tid] == 1
44:                 mask[tid] = 0
45:                 for i in node_start[tid]:(node_start[tid] + node_ne[tid] - 1)
46:                     id = edges[i + 1]
47:                     if visited[id + 1] == 0
48:                         cost[id + 1] = cost[tid] + 1
49:                         umask[id + 1] = 1
50:                     end
51:                 end
52:             end
53:         end
54:         for tid in 1:N
55:             if umask[tid] == 1
56:                 mask[tid] = 1
57:                 visited[tid] = 1
58:                 stop = true
59:                 umask[tid] = 0
60:             end
61:         end
62:         if !stop; break; end
63:     end
64: end

42:     z = (blockIdx().z - Int32(1)) * blockDim().z + threadIdx().z

45:         iy = y + radius
46:         iz = z + radius
47:         idx = ix + (iy - Int32(1)) * ox + (iz - Int32(1)) * ox * oy
48:         value = coeff[1] * inp[idx]
49:         r = Int32(1)
50:         while r <= radius
51:             c = coeff[Int(r + Int32(1))]
52:             value += c * (inp[idx + r] + inp[idx - r])
53:             value += c * (inp[idx + r * ox] + inp[idx - r * ox])
54:             value += c * (inp[idx + r * ox * oy] + inp[idx - r * ox * oy])

4: # Julia port of jacobi-cuda benchmark. 2D Jacobi relaxation until L2 error
5: # falls below tolerance. Uses plain-global-memory 4-point stencil (simpler
6: # than the shared-mem tiled version) plus atomic error accumulation.
7: 
8: const NX = 2048
9: 
10: @inline idx_lin(i, j, N) = (i - 1) + (j - 1) * N + 1   # column-major 1-based
11: 
12: function jacobi_kernel!(f, f_old, err_arr, N::Int32)
13:     tx = Int32(threadIdx().x)  # 1..16
14:     ty = Int32(threadIdx().y)
15:     i = tx + Int32((blockIdx().x - 1)) * Int32(blockDim().x)  # 1..N
16:     j = ty + Int32((blockIdx().y - 1)) * Int32(blockDim().y)
17: 
18:     err = 0.0f0
19:     @inbounds if i >= Int32(2) && i <= N - Int32(1) && j >= Int32(2) && j <= N - Int32(1)
20:         c = (i - Int32(1)) + (j - Int32(1)) * N + Int32(1)
21:         ip = c + Int32(1)
22:         im = c - Int32(1)
23:         jp = c + N
24:         jm = c - N
25:         val = 0.25f0 * (f_old[ip] + f_old[im] + f_old[jp] + f_old[jm])
26:         f[c] = val
27:         df = val - f_old[c]
28:         err = df * df
29:     end
30:     # Simple: each thread with err > 0 atomic-adds. Fine for correctness.
31:     if err > 0.0f0
32:         CUDA.@atomic err_arr[1] += err
33:     end
34:     return
35: end
36: 
37: function initialize_data!(f, N)
38:     two_pi = 2 * pi
39:     for j in 1:N, i in 1:N
40:         if i == 1 || i == N
41:             f[i + (j - 1) * N] = Float32(sin((j - 1) * two_pi / (N - 1)))
42:         elseif j == 1 || j == N
43:             f[i + (j - 1) * N] = Float32(sin((i - 1) * two_pi / (N - 1)))
44:         else
45:             f[i + (j - 1) * N] = 0.0f0
46:         end
47:     end
48: end
49: 
50: function main()
51:     N = NX
52:     f = Vector{Float32}(undef, N * N)
53:     f_old = Vector{Float32}(undef, N * N)
54:     initialize_data!(f, N)
55:     initialize_data!(f_old, N)
56: 
57:     d_f = CuArray(f)
58:     d_f_old = CuArray(f_old)
59:     d_err = CUDA.zeros(Float32, 1)
60: 
61:     error = typemax(Float32)
62:     tolerance = 1f-5
63:     max_iters = 10000
64:     num_iters = 0
65: 
66:     threads = (16, 16)
67:     blocks = (cld(N, 16), cld(N, 16))
68: 
69:     CUDA.synchronize()
70:     t0 = time_ns()
71: 
72:     while error > tolerance && num_iters < max_iters
73:         CUDA.fill!(d_err, 0f0)
74:         @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks jacobi_kernel!(d_f, d_f_old, d_err, Int32(N))
75:         d_f, d_f_old = d_f_old, d_f
76:         e = CUDA.@allowscalar d_err[1]
77:         error = sqrt(e / (N * N))
78:         if num_iters % 1000 == 0
79:             @printf("Error after iteration %d = %g\n", num_iters, error)
80:         end
81:         num_iters += 1
82:     end
83:     CUDA.synchronize()
84:     elapsed_s = (time_ns() - t0) * 1e-9 / max(num_iters, 1)
85:     @printf("Average execution time per iteration: %g (s)\n", elapsed_s)
86: 
87:     if error <= tolerance && num_iters < max_iters
88:         println("PASS")
89:     else
90:         println("FAIL")
91:     end
92:     return 0
93: end

4: # Julia port of triad-cuda benchmark (simplified)
5: # Kernel: C = A + s*B
6: 
7: function triad_kernel!(A, B, C, s::Float32)
8:     gid = Int32((blockIdx().x - 1)) * Int32(blockDim().x) + Int32(threadIdx().x)
9:     @inbounds if gid <= length(C)
10:         C[gid] = A[gid] + s * B[gid]
11:     end
12:     return
13: end

15: function main()
16:     # Skip flag-style args (--passes N -v etc.); accept the first positional
17:     # numeric argument as `passes` for compatibility with the CUDA CLI.
18:     numeric = filter(a -> !startswith(a, "-"), ARGS)
19:     passes_from_flag = ""
20:     for i in 1:length(ARGS)-1
21:         if ARGS[i] in ("--passes","-p") && !startswith(ARGS[i+1], "-")
22:             passes_from_flag = ARGS[i+1]
23:         end
24:     end
25:     if passes_from_flag != ""
26:         pushfirst!(numeric, passes_from_flag)
27:     end
28:     if length(numeric) < 1
29:         println("Usage: main.jl <passes>  (or --passes N)")
30:         return 1
31:     end
32:     n_passes = parse(Int, numeric[1])
33: 
34:     # 8M floats total, but split into two halves and pipelined in CUDA version;
35:     # here we run a single fixed-size pass and verify halves match.
36:     numMaxFloats = 1024 * 16384 ÷ sizeof(Float32)   # 4,194,304 floats = 16 MB
37:     halfNumFloats = numMaxFloats ÷ 2
38: 
39:     scalar = 1.75f0
40: 
41:     # Deterministic init: fill both halves identically
42:     h_mem = Vector{Float32}(undef, numMaxFloats)
43:     state = Ref(UInt64(8650341))
44:     function next_f32()
45:         state[] = state[] * UInt64(6364136223846793005) + UInt64(1442695040888963407)
46:         return Float32(((state[] >> 11) & UInt64(0xFFFFFF))) / Float32(1 << 24) * 10.0f0
47:     end
48:     for j in 1:halfNumFloats
49:         v = next_f32()
50:         h_mem[j] = v
51:         h_mem[j + halfNumFloats] = v
52:     end
53: 
54:     # Use just one buffer set; time triad kernel over the full array
55:     d_A = CuArray(h_mem)
56:     d_B = CuArray(h_mem)
57:     d_C = CUDA.zeros(Float32, numMaxFloats)
58: 
59:     threads = 128
60:     blocks  = cld(numMaxFloats, threads)
61: 
62:     # Warmup + timing
63:     CUDA.synchronize()
64:     t0 = time_ns()
65:     for _ in 1:n_passes
66:         @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks triad_kernel!(d_A, d_B, d_C, scalar)
67:     end
68:     CUDA.synchronize()
69:     elapsed = (time_ns() - t0) * 1e-9
70:     gflops = (2.0 * numMaxFloats * n_passes) / (elapsed * 1e9)
71:     bdwth  = (Float64(sizeof(Float32)) * 3.0 * numMaxFloats * n_passes) / (elapsed * 1e9)
72:     @printf("Average TriadFlops %f GFLOPS/s\n", gflops)
73:     @printf("Average TriadBdwth %f GB/s\n", bdwth)
74: 
75:     C_gpu = Array(d_C)
76: 
77:     # Verify: for identical halves, both should equal A + s*B
78:     ok = true
79:     for j in 1:halfNumFloats
80:         ref = h_mem[j] + scalar * h_mem[j]
81:         if abs(C_gpu[j] - ref) > 1e-3 || C_gpu[j] != C_gpu[j + halfNumFloats]
82:             ok = false
83:             break
84:         end
85:     end

87:     println(ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
